subject: Customer spotlight & appreciation pack — choose your preference
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Allen <sophie@brightlane.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Customer spotlight & appreciation pack — choose your preference

Hi Sophie,

Thanks again for agreeing to a short customer spotlight — really appreciate BrightLane taking the time. As a small thank-you, we typically offer a $500 account credit plus an appreciation pack (hoodie + insulated mug) or, if you prefer, we can make a $500 donation to a charity of your choice and send you the donation receipt.

Could you let me know which option you'd prefer and where you'd like us to ship the appreciation pack if you pick that? If you choose the donation, please let me know the organization name, the payee details for the receipt, and any tax ID we should include.

I attached the appreciation pack options so you can pick hoodie size/color if you go that route.

Best,
Irene Choi
Customer Marketing Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: appreciation_pack_options.pdf

From: Sophie Allen <sophie@brightlane.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Customer spotlight & appreciation pack — choose your preference

Hi Irene,

Huge thanks — we9d prefer you make the donation on our behalf rather than the swag. BrightLane Foundation is our non-profit arm and would be perfect. Please make the donation to: BrightLane Foundation, EIN 12-3456789, donations@brightlanefoundation.org. We9d appreciate a PDF receipt made out to "BrightLane Foundation."

If you still want a postal address for records, you can use: BrightLane, 420 Harbor Ave, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94107. No need to send physical swag in that case.

Happy to confirm the spotlight timing separately — thanks again.

— Sophie
Head of Partnerships, BrightLane Inc.

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Customer spotlight & appreciation pack — BrightLane prefers donation

Team, forwarding Sophie9s note — BrightLane wants a $500 donation to BrightLane Foundation (EIN 12-3456789) instead of the physical pack. Can we please do the following:

- Neha: apply a $500 promotional credit to BrightLane9s account (deal HS-82644) and confirm when that posts.
- Marissa: arrange the donation payment to BrightLane Foundation and produce a donation receipt PDF we can forward to Sophie (make receipt payable to "BrightLane Foundation"). Use the tax ID above for the receipt.

I9m not shipping anything, so no hoodie/mug. Please confirm timelines — Sophie9s team would like the receipt for their records this week if possible.

Thanks,
Irene

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Customer spotlight & appreciation pack — BrightLane prefers donation

Got it — I9ll handle the donation logistics. I9ll schedule the $500 grant through our advocacy budget and generate the donation receipt PDF. Attaching the internal shipping & vendor form in case Finance needs it (though we won9t ship anything for this request).

Estimate: donation processed and receipt ready by Monday 11/23 EOD. If Finance needs additional approvals I9ll loop them.

Attachment: shipping_form.xlsx

—Marissa
Program Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sophie Allen <sophie@brightlane.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Customer spotlight & appreciation pack — BrightLane prefers donation

Hi all,

Quick update: the $500 promotional credit has been posted to BrightLane9s account (deal HS-82644) and will appear on their next invoice. Marissa confirmed the donation to BrightLane Foundation went through this morning; I9ve attached the official donation receipt (PDF) for your records and forwarded a copy to donations@brightlanefoundation.org.

Sophie — attached is the donation_receipt_BrightLaneFoundation.pdf. Let me know if you need any additional line-item details on the accounting side.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
